newsitem.title: RUSSIA: KARATE-RUSSIAN SQUAD MEMBER KILLED DURING BOUT.
newsitem.headline: KARATE-RUSSIAN SQUAD MEMBER KILLED DURING BOUT.

text.p: A 23-year-old member of the Russian national karate squad was killed by a single blow to the neck during a local championship bout at the weekend, a sports administrator in the central city of Penza said on Thursday.
"It was a fatal coincidence, a one in 10,000 chance," Alexander Zalozhnikov of Penza sports authority told Reuters.
Local fighter Vadim Kafarov, who took part in the 1995 European championships, was felled by a strike to his carotid artery which cut the oxygen supply to his brain, he said.
Despite medical attention, he died almost immediately.
